import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Source file path
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_3/test_0.csv"
    
    # Load source data
    df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)
    
    # Inspect columns (for clarity, not strictly necessary)
    # print(df_source0.columns)
    
    # Transformation plan:
    # - Target schema: ['Major_category': string, 'Median': float]
    # - From source, group by 'Major_category'
    # - Aggregate 'Median' by average (mean) because multiple majors belong to the same category
    # - Resulting dataframe should have one row per Major_category with the average Median
    
    # Group by Major_category and calculate average Median
    df_target = df_source0.groupby('Major_category', as_index=False)['Median'].mean()
    
    # Ensure correct data types
    df_target['Major_category'] = df_target['Major_category'].astype(str)
    df_target['Median'] = df_target['Median'].astype(float)
    
    # Output path
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_3/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    
    # Save the transformed data to CSV
    df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
    
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
